items.title: 'We Are Pro-Human Creativity' — Nexus Mods Forces Mandatory AI Disclosures and Filters, Explains Why It Won't Ban AI Mods
items.excerpt: Nexus Mods now requires disclosure for mods with AI-assisted code or assets and lets users filter AI-assisted mods out of browsing, arguing an outright ban would only push AI use underground.
items.rationale: New platform policy on the biggest mod site: mandatory AI disclosure plus a user-side filter. IGN reported it first and has the cleanest version of the three outlets that covered it.

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints from the start to put AI productivity first, Tim Sweeney says in an apologetic Unreal Fest Tokyo 2026 keynote
items.excerpt: At Unreal Fest Tokyo 2026 Tim Sweeney said Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints from the start rather than phase them out, prioritising AI-agent productivity, and apologised for the change.
items.rationale: A concrete engine decision with direct workflow impact: dropping Blueprints, the visual-scripting layer that many designers and technical artists rely on, in favour of AI-agent workflows. It came from the Epic CEO on stage, and 4Gamer reported it first-hand.

items.title: Power Moon Recomp: an unofficial native PC port of Super Mario Odyssey, built with the Claude coding agent, runs at 4K/60
items.excerpt: An unofficial static-recompilation port runs Super Mario Odyssey natively on PC at up to 4K/60fps; the developer says it was built with heavy help from the Claude AI coding agent, shipping seven versions in about 30 hours.
items.rationale: A new release in the AI-assisted recomp wave, and the first big one to land after the 11-02 reports that Anthropic is curbing Claude game remakes. The developer's account of seven versions in about 30 hours is a concrete data point on speed. The copy should state that the port is unofficial and the claims are the developer's own.

items.title: Best WoW Forever add-ons to avoid AI slop
items.excerpt: AI-generated add-ons are flooding CurseForge for World of Warcraft: Forever as low-effort near-duplicates that raise testing, maintenance, security and Blizzard TOS concerns. Destructoid points players to handcrafted alternatives such as Questie and Dialogue UI.
items.rationale: A fresh (11-04) report that the flood of AI slop has reached CurseForge's WoW Forever add-on catalogue, with a practical list of handcrafted alternatives. It is a different event from the 10-18 card about Blizzard's trailer being accused of AI use.

items.title: Y Combinator and Olam Labs let 50 AI agents build a civilisation in Minecraft, and they formed a timid bureaucracy
items.excerpt: Y Combinator and Olam Labs published 'Agents in Games', a study letting 50 AI agents build a civilisation in Minecraft; the agents formed a timid, bureaucratic society.
items.rationale: A newly published multi-agent study ('Agents in Games') with findings that matter to anyone designing agent-driven NPCs or social systems. It is distinct from the 10-21 Google Ender Dragon card, which was about a single agent finishing the game, not emergent group behaviour.
